paragraphs: Ireland leads the EU Council now. Next week, many European leaders will come to Dublin for big meetings. The meetings are at the Convention Centre. Police will close many roads.
This is bad news for some shops and tourist businesses. Visitors will need to show ID. Police may stop and search them. Boats cannot use part of the river.
John O'Neill runs a famous old ship and a river boat trip. The boat trips must stop for two days. He will give money back to customers.
A Japanese restaurant has lost one booking. A shop near Merrion Square will close on Thursday. But John says the meetings are good for Ireland.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭現在是歐盟理事會的輪值主席國。
下週，許多歐洲領袖將來都柏林參加大型會議。
會議在會議中心舉行。
警察將封閉許多道路。
這對一些商店和觀光業者來說是壞消息。
訪客需要出示身分證件。
警察可能會攔下他們並搜查。
部分河段將禁止船隻通行。
約翰·奧尼爾經營一艘有名的老船和河上遊船行程。
遊船行程必須停駛兩天。
他將退錢給顧客。
一家日本餐廳已經失去一筆訂位。
梅瑞恩廣場附近的一家商店將在週四關門。
但約翰說這些會議對愛爾蘭有好處。

paragraphs: Businesses in Dublin are getting ready for big EU meetings next week. The meetings will take place at the Convention Centre because Ireland now leads the Council of the EU. Many roads will close and there will be long delays.
Gardaí gave local businesses a leaflet about ten days ago. Businesses do not have to close, but it will be hard for staff and visitors to reach them. People may be stopped, searched and asked for ID.

John O'Neill runs the Jeanie Johnston, an old tall ship, and a river cruise on North Wall Quay. Groups who booked months ago must now bring extra papers. The river cruises must stop for two days because boats cannot use the Liffey, and he will have to give refunds. Still, he says hosting the meetings is very good for the country.
Other businesses are worried too. A Japanese restaurant has lost a booking, and a shop near Merrion Square will close on Thursday, when leaders have a dinner at the National Gallery.
sentZh: 都柏林的商家正在為下週的大型歐盟會議做準備。
因為愛爾蘭目前領導歐盟理事會，會議將在會議中心舉行。
許多道路將封閉，也會有嚴重延誤。
大約十天前，警方發給當地商家一張傳單。
商家不必關門，但員工和訪客將很難到達。
民眾可能會被攔下、搜查並被要求出示證件。
約翰·奧尼爾經營老式高桅帆船Jeanie Johnston號，以及在北牆碼頭的河上遊船。
幾個月前預訂的團體現在必須攜帶額外文件。
因為船隻不能使用利菲河，河上遊船必須停駛兩天，他將必須退款。
儘管如此，他說主辦這些會議對國家非常有益。
其他商家也很擔心。
一家日本餐廳失去了一筆訂位，梅瑞恩廣場附近的一家商店將在週四關門，那天領袖們將在國家美術館享用晚宴。

paragraphs: Businesses in Dublin's docklands and city centre are bracing for disruption as major EU summits take place at the Convention Centre next week as part of Ireland's Presidency of the Council of the EU. The State's biggest-ever policing operation will bring road closures and delays across the city.
Gardaí gave businesses about ten days' notice in a leaflet. Firms have not been told to close, but visitors will face stop-and-search and identity checks at the security cordon.

John O'Neill, who operates the Jeanie Johnston tall ship and a river cruise on North Wall Quay, said group customers who booked months in advance must now carry extra documents. An exclusion zone on the Liffey means his cruises must stop completely for two days, so he will have to issue refunds. He called the approach too broad, although he admitted that hosting such events is good for Ireland.
Elsewhere, a Japanese restaurant has already had a cancellation, and a garden shop on Clare Street will close on Thursday, when a formal dinner is held at the National Gallery.
sentZh: 隨著下週會議中心將舉辦作為愛爾蘭擔任歐盟理事會輪值主席國一環的重要歐盟峰會，都柏林碼頭區和市中心的商家正為交通混亂做好準備。
國家史上最大規模的警力部署將在全市帶來封路和延誤。
警方透過傳單提前約十天通知商家。
商家沒有被要求關門，但訪客在安全封鎖線將面臨攔停搜查和身分檢查。
在北牆碼頭經營高桅帆船Jeanie Johnston號和河上遊船的約翰·奧尼爾說，幾個月前預訂的團體客人現在必須攜帶額外文件。
利菲河上的禁航區意味著他的遊船必須完全停駛兩天，因此他得辦理退款。
他稱這種做法範圍太廣，但也承認主辦這類活動對愛爾蘭有好處。
在其他地方，一家日本餐廳已經有人取消訂位，而克萊爾街的一家園藝商店將在週四關門，當天國家美術館將舉行正式晚宴。

paragraphs: Traders across Dublin's docklands and city centre are bracing themselves for upheaval next week, when the Convention Centre hosts high-profile EU summits under Ireland's Presidency of the Council of the EU. What is billed as the State's largest-ever policing operation will entail sweeping road closures and gridlock.

Gardaí circulated leaflets roughly ten days in advance. Businesses have not been ordered to shut, yet anyone venturing inside the security cordon must submit to stop-and-search procedures and identity checks.

John O'Neill, who runs the Jeanie Johnston tall ship and a river cruise on North Wall Quay, says groups that booked months ago must now produce supplementary paperwork, and he anticipates that casual footfall will plummet. With an exclusion zone imposed on the Liffey, his cruises will be suspended for two days, obliging him to issue refunds. He branded the measures a blanket approach, while conceding that staging such gatherings is a coup for the country.

Others are equally apprehensive: a Japanese restaurant has already fielded a cancellation, and a garden shop on Clare Street will shutter on Thursday, the evening of a formal dinner at the National Gallery.

商家並未被勒令關門，但任何進入安全封鎖線的人都必須接受攔停搜查程序和身分檢查。
經營高桅帆船Jeanie Johnston號和北牆碼頭河上遊船的約翰·奧尼爾說，幾個月前訂位的團體現在必須出示補充文件，他也預期散客人流將大幅下滑。
由於利菲河實施禁航區，他的遊船將暫停兩天，迫使他必須辦理退款。
他批評這些措施是一刀切的做法，但也承認舉辦此類聚會對國家而言是一大成就。
其他業者同樣憂心忡忡：一家日本餐廳已經接到一筆取消，克萊爾街的一家園藝商店將在週四歇業，當晚國家美術館將舉行正式晚宴。
